name: myfolio-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool manifest for MyFolio AI Portfolio Synthesizer

tools.name: generate_portfolio
tools.description: Synthesizes an interactive 3D WebGL developer portfolio from a public GitHub username in under 60 seconds. Free evaluation: 3 builds/week.

github_username.description: GitHub username or profile handle to ingest

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists all available 3D developer universes, aesthetics, and recommended roles.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns current transparent pricing: Free evaluation (3 builds/wk), Lifetime Build (₹149 one-time with ZIP export), and Pro Domain (₹149/mo).

tools.name: get_readme_badge
tools.description: Generates a markdown badge snippet for a developer's GitHub README linking to their 3D MyFolio portfolio.
